主要内容: On January 26, 2022, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note outlining the decisions made to implement the monetary policy stance announced by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The Board of Governors voted unanimously to maintain the interest rate paid on reserve balances at 0.15 percent, effective January 27, 2022. The FOMC authorized the Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York to execute transactions in the System Open Market Account (SOMA) in accordance with specific directives. These included maintaining the federal funds rate within a target range of 0 to 1/4 percent, increasing Treasury securities holdings by $40 billion and agency MBS by $20 billion, and conducting overnight repurchase and reverse repurchase agreement operations. The note also outlined the reinvestment of principal payments and the use of dollar roll and coupon swap transactions to facilitate settlement. The primary credit rate was set at 0.25 percent, reflecting the existing level.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
